    1. copy()

Interface Copyable<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of the copied object
All Known Subinterfaces:
ISeq<T>, MSeq<T>
All Known Implementing Classes:
CharSeq, Engine.Builder, TreeNode
public interface Copyable<T>
This interface indicates that a class can create a copy of type T. Typically, classes which implement this interface are able to create a copy from themselves.
